name: GMKtec
hq: Shenzhen, China (search summary, unverified at primary)
approach: Sells the shared Sixunited AXB35-02 Strix Halo board in its own chassis (EVO-X2) and a larger OCuLink chassis with the same SoC (EVO-X3) at roughly 1.75x the EVO-X2 64GB EU list. Competes on list price and frequent sale pricing, not on a distinct board.

techChoices.choice: Soldered LPDDR5X on every Strix Halo and Intel Lunar/Panther model; SO-DIMM only on K11, K8 Plus and M-series
External Huntkey PSU on the EVO-X2; 8-14 W idle, 147-160 W under 70B load
Single 2.5GbE on EVO-X2; OCuLink only on EVO-X3
41-43 dBA under AI load at the STH test position

euTerms.note: Return window and restocking fee read shorter than the EU 14-day withdrawal right; needs a legal check. Shipping policy summary mentions declaring a lower commodity value: treat as a compliance risk, never as a method.

strengths: Lowest official EU list price for a complete 64GB Strix Halo machine seen (EUR 1,999.99)
Large model range incl. serviceable K11
weaknesses: 128GB EU official price not extracted; independent retail EUR 3,999-4,450 incl. VAT
Short EU return window, restocking fee

name: Minisforum
hq: Shenzhen, China (search digest of About page, unverified at primary)
approach: Designs its own boards and chassis and positions the MS-S1 MAX as a workstation: internal 320 W PSU, 2x10GbE, PCIe x16 slot wired x4, rack and two-unit cluster marketing. Also sells SO-DIMM machines (AI X1 Pro up to 96GB) and announced a Strix Halo mini-ITX board (BD395i MAX).

techChoices.choice: Internal Lite-On 320 W PSU in the MS-S1 MAX; about 10 W idle in Windows, 200-220 W peak
PCIe 4.0 x16 slot that is x4 electrically; no OCuLink on MS-S1 MAX; OCuLink on AI X1 Pro
Soldered 64/128/192GB on Strix Halo models; SO-DIMM on AI X1 Pro

euTerms.note: UK page read: 24 months standard (36 months promotion ended 2026-07-31), 30-day returns, customer pays return shipping. EU/NL policy page not opened. Store sells a EUR 30 'Duty Free Shipping Service' and 'Tariff Insurance' as products: customs handling unverified.

strengths: Own board design and best-documented workstation feature set
Wholesale route from 10 units with 3-year warranty
weaknesses: EU list is high (EUR 3,999 sale / 4,999 regular for 128GB)
BIOS issues reported on AI X1 Pro (one owner) and a loud idle on early MS-S1 MAX fixed by BIOS v1.03 (Notebookcheck, via search digest)
No independent EU merchant price verified

name: Framework
approach: Standard mini-ITX mainboard sold separately and as a DIY or prebuilt Desktop, with named component partners and public price explanations. Raised prices during the 2026 DRAM shortage and states it will cut when the market calms.

techChoices.choice: Semi-custom FSP 400 W Flex ATX PSU
Cooler Master and Noctua co-developed thermal system
AMD-supplied Strix Halo platform; 192GB Max+ PRO 495 variant ships Nov 2026

euTerms.note: Support and warranty terms not read.

strengths: Named suppliers, serviceable, EU store with VAT-inclusive prices
Mainboard sold alone: closest thing to a build-your-own Strix Halo
weaknesses: 128GB mainboard alone EUR 3,539 incl. VAT, about EUR 1,100 above a complete Bosgame M5 128GB seen in June
Out of stock on fetch day for 32/64/128GB DIY

name: Bosgame
approach: Sells the Sixunited-platform M5 at the lowest complete-system price found: EUR 2,439.95 for 128GB/2TB on 24 June 2026 (cut from EUR 2,875.95). One June observation only; bosgamepc.com blocked live fetches.
strengths: Cheapest credible complete 128GB machine in the data
weaknesses: Stuck power button and limited BIOS updates reported in the community wiki

name: Beelink
approach: GTR9 Pro uses a board the community wiki treats as distinct from Sixunited, with early stability problems in owner threads. Offers ODM/OEM services and wholesale.
weaknesses: USD price on DE page with 35-day pre-order; stability reports are forum-level evidence

name: HP
approach: Z2 Mini G1a is a Strix Halo workstation sold through business resellers: EUR 3,890.15 incl. VAT for 128GB/1TB at a Dutch reseller, ships when available; the 2x1TB SKU on the same listing is EUR 7,025.26.
strengths: Cheapest verified in-NL 128GB listing with VAT stated
weaknesses: B2B channel, SKU ambiguity, OS on SKU not stated

name: Corsair
approach: AI Workstation 300 is on the Sixunited platform per the community wiki. List price rose from USD 1,999.99 at launch to 2,699.99 from, max USD 3,399.99.

euTerms.note: EU availability and price not verified.

name: AMD
approach: Supplies the Strix Halo silicon and sells its own Ryzen AI Halo reference mini PC (launched 10 July 2026 in the US; about EUR 4,100 in Germany per Notebookcheck, approximate). A Medusa Halo successor with LPDDR6 is a rumor for 2027-28.

name: NVIDIA
approach: DGX Spark (GB10) is Linux-only (DGX OS) with CUDA; USD 3,999 at launch, USD 4,699 after a February 2026 rise. OEM GB10 boxes (ASUS, Gigabyte, Dell, Lenovo, MSI, HP, Acer) list USD 5,400-8,200 with stock-outs.
strengths: Fast prompt processing (pp about 1956 t/s on gpt-oss-120b)

name: ASUS
approach: Ascent GX10 is an ASUS GB10 box: USD 6,999 on the ASUS US store (forum report) and EUR 3,680 ex VAT in one forum post. Neither is a verified EU merchant price.

name: Apple
approach: Vertically integrated unified memory: Mac Studio M5 Max 460/614 GB/s (to 128GB), M5 Ultra 1.2 TB/s (96GB base, 512GB max), Mac mini M5 Pro 307 GB/s (64GB max). macOS only. Raised Mac mini prices by EUR 300-350 over the M4 generation.

techChoices.choice: Unified memory; GPU wired limit adjustable via iogpu.wired_limit_mb

strengths: Memory bandwidth 1.2x to 4.7x Strix Halo's 256 GB/s theoretical
weaknesses: Apple NL pages show no prices (prices taken from iCulture / EveryMac)
Apple affiliate covers digital content only, not Mac hardware
